posts.name: Alex
posts.cooked:
I know I've met several of you, but I'm really bad at remembering names (I remember people by their voices first and faces second), let alone remembering which meatspace names connect with what online handles. That's part of the reason why I just made my username my actual name and my avatar an actual photo of me. The other part is laziness. OK, mostly laziness. Whatever.

I've met people on two occasions, both times when I went to PAX East. The first was in 2011, when Kismet and the other Shattered Timelines characters were being shown off. The second was this most recent con, in 2016.

Off the top of my head, I'm pretty sure I met arenson in person. Also kz3rt, but that's cheating because we're friends in real life and I don't think he's posted here in a while, and a really cool unity cosplayer whose name I believe was Emily/Sejixs.

The lesson here is that if you want me to remember you, either go to college with me and teach me a really neat superhero card game, or be the only person at a booth dressed in bright pink and wearing goggles.
